description: Reserve a restaurant table. The caller gives a party size, date, and time, and the agent may only reserve a table the restaurant still has.

tools.name: check_tables
tools.description: Check which tables fit a party size at a date and time.

tools.name: reserve_table
tools.description: Reserve a table under a name after the caller confirms the details.

constraints: Collect name, party size, date, and time before reserving.
Call check_tables before reserve_table. If it returns no_table, do not reserve.
Call reserve_table only after the caller explicitly confirms name, party size, date, and time.
Party size must be a positive number the caller stated. Do not pick one for them.
success_criteria: The reservation matches the confirmed name, party size, date, and time.
reserve_table is not called when confirmation is missing or check_tables failed.
